item.title: Huge fire in Scotland triggers train chaos as historic building partially collapses
item.description: By Laura Sharman, CNN (CNN) — A massive fire near one of Scotland’s busiest train stations has engulfed a historic building in Glasgow, causing it to partially collapse. Dozens of firefighters scrambled at Union Street just before 4 p.m. Sunday after the blaze started on the ground floor of a four-story commercial building, crews said.
